image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale's head and upper back emerging from blue ocean water. The skin is dark grey with distinctive white mottling (barnacles/lice). The rostrum is arched, and the dorsal area shows the characteristic knuckles rather than a fin. The water surface interacts realistically with the whale's body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the arched rostrum typical of grey whales. While the blowholes are partially obscured by the angle and water reflection, the overall head shape matches the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive white mottling pattern caused by cyamids and barnacles is highly visible and accurate to the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is no dorsal fin. The ridge behind the head shows the beginning of the dorsal knuckle series, consistent with grey whale anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior portion of the whale is visible; the full spindle shape cannot be verified due to cropping.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; the visible skin texture and coloration are correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and underwater; baleen plates are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are submerged and not visible in this frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin exhibits the rough, bumpy texture associated with callosities and barnacle clusters.
